resources.string: Create a 4–6 digit PIN to protect the Telegram account you signed in to. The entered digits and PIN length are not displayed. There is no PIN recovery: losing it can make local data inaccessible.
Enter the PIN and press Continue. The entered digits and their count are intentionally hidden.
The application PIN protects access after signing in. The emergency PIN, entered instead of it under coercion, signs out of every account and destroys local data.

The emergency PIN destroys only the device it was typed on. With this on, that device first writes a 24-character line into Saved Messages and waits for the server, and only then wipes itself, while every other NovaGram client of the account does the same - even one with no PIN. A line older than the last login is refused; with no network the wait ends after 12 seconds.

Blocks screenshots and screen recording of the whole NovaGram window, the recents thumbnail included, and does not need a Telegram passcode to do it. Instant View articles and mini apps draw in windows of their own and are not covered.
The PIN values did not match. Create the PIN again.
Incorrect PIN. The keypad order has been changed.
This device did not provide a StrongBox or TEE-backed key. Software protection is weaker and will not hold against a compromised operating system.
Protected PIN state is missing or damaged. NovaGram fails closed and will not open Telegram data. Reinstall the application only if losing its local data is acceptable.
Protected storage is temporarily unavailable. NovaGram will not downgrade or open Telegram data without PIN protection.
Calls are disabled until protected signaling and media routing are implemented.
Enter the PIN you use to unlock NovaGram.

The emergency PIN is entered instead of the usual one under coercion. It never unlocks NovaGram: it signs out of every account and destroys the local data, after which the application keeps working as an empty client. The Telegram cloud history and the copies held by other people are not removed. It must differ from the usual PIN.
The emergency PIN must differ from the usual one.
The emergency PIN could not be saved.
The version number opens the release it was built from, with the list of what changed. Based on Telegram Android %1$s.

A file the application stores by itself gets a meaningless name instead of the one it came with, so a listing of the Telegram Documents folder tells nothing. Saving a file on purpose from the chat menu keeps its real name.

Metadata blocks — Exif, XMP, IPTC, comments — are cut out of the JPEG and PNG files you send, which is the camera, the time and the place. Other formats, HEIC, PDF and video among them, are sent as they are.

Everything this person sends from now on is deleted on this device before it is stored, shown or announced — no notification, no unread badge, no way to read it later. Nothing is deleted for them: their chat and their messages stay as they are, and they keep seeing the messages as unread. Switches itself off as soon as you send anything here — a message or a reaction.
Messages of yours found: %1$d Destroyed: %2$d · replaced with a dot: %3$d · skipped: %4$d
Left in the queue: %1$d. This window closes itself once the queue is through — leave it up to watch.
Done. This window closes in a few seconds.

This client has no access key for that number. Telegram does not allow opening a peer by a bare number: it has to be met in a chat, by @name, by phone number or by link. The number alone does not even say whether it is a person, a group or a channel.
Put this icon on the home screen

The icon is drawn rather than taken from a file, which is why there are 3840 combinations. Android does not let an application replace its own launcher icon — that one lives inside the signed package — so the chosen mark is offered as a shortcut the system adds beside it, with your consent. Inside the application the new mark is used at once.
The system was asked to add the shortcut. If nothing appeared, your launcher does not accept pinned shortcuts.
This launcher does not accept pinned shortcuts, so the icon can only be used inside the application.

A sticker built to kill the client instead of being drawn never reaches the decoder: a “Crash sticker (defused)” plate takes its place. The size, the dimensions, the length and the shape of the file itself are checked — a sticker made by Telegram’s own rules is nowhere near the limits.

At most once every eight hours NovaGram asks GitHub for the latest release of this project — the only network request it makes outside Telegram, and all it reveals is that the client is running. The package is verified against a checksum, and installing it over the current one keeps chats and settings.
The update is ready to install

Your own sent messages are deleted once the period passes, counted from the moment they were sent. Messages sent before this was switched on are not queued — use Erase evidence in the chat menu for those. Chats where you have admin rights and Saved Messages are left alone.
Auto-delete my messages in this group
Keep my messages in this group
Only your own traces in this chat are destroyed: the messages, files, voice and video you sent. The other side\'s messages are left alone.\n\nThe operation cannot be undone.
Reactions are removed from the messages found in this chat. Telegram offers no way to ask the server where this account reacted, so reactions on messages outside the chosen period are not covered.
Destroy your messages and reactions in this chat: %1$s?
Queued for destruction: %1$d. The result follows once the queue is through.
No messages of yours in this period
Queued for destruction: %1$d. The chat could not be walked to the end, so older messages in this period were not covered — run it again.
Deleted %1$d, of them replaced with a dot first %2$d, skipped %3$d.
In this dialog the other side does not see the read marks. Hiding ends by itself the moment you send anything here, and that cannot be undone.

Turning it off cannot be undone: once the receipt reaches the server the other side sees the messages as read, and hiding cannot be restored in this dialog. Sending a message here does exactly the same, so there is no need to press this before answering.
The other side cannot see that you read this. Answering here turns it off, as does the chat menu.

When a stranger writes to you and you have not answered yet, the read marks are never sent to them. The rule is made on the first such message; groups, channels, bots and Saved Messages are left alone. An answer or a reaction of yours lifts it for good, and for Telegram such a conversation stays unread.

Names NovaGram resolves itself go through this list and nothing else: neither the system, nor the network, nor Private DNS affects it or stands in for it. Inside web pages and mini apps names are resolved by the system WebView.
Tried in this order; the first to answer wins. A server of your own is resolved through the built-in ones that are on, and sees every name this client asks about.
The other side never sees your IP address: voice and video go through a relay instead of straight to them. Calls are a little slower, and their traffic passes through Telegram.
Between 22:00 and 07:00 in local time, outgoing messages arrive without a notification sound. The message is delivered as usual; only the notification is silent.

The text inside a push is put there by the Telegram server: the switch forbids that for the whole account, so a push carries the sender name and the text is loaded here, from the message itself. It is an account setting, not a device one: previews switch off on your other devices, and under Doze the text may not arrive.

The message text disappears from the notification, and with it photos, stickers and voice messages: in its place there is a line saying that a message has arrived. This hides them from whoever can see the screen, not from the servers: the sender name and the chat name stay where they are.

The PIN will stop being asked for, and the emergency PIN will be removed with it: it can only ever be entered on the PIN screen, and without a PIN there is no such screen. Local data stays where it is. You will be asked for the current PIN.
Enter the current PIN to remove it. The emergency PIN is removed together with it. The entered digits and their count are intentionally hidden.
The application PIN has been turned off.
Every time the app is minimised
Every time the device is locked

The chosen option is the only thing that decides when the PIN is asked for again. \"Only when the app starts\" also expires after a day: a process can live for weeks. Inactivity is measured from touches, typing and media.
Messages from %1$s in this chat will never notify you and will collapse into a dimmed line. Tap the line to read one. Nothing is sent anywhere: the other side cannot tell.
Messages from %1$s in this chat will notify you and be shown in full again.
This data belongs to another device

The authorisation keys stored here are sealed with a key that lives inside this device and never leaves it. That key is not present, so these files cannot sign anyone in.\n\nIf this is your own phone and you restored the app from a backup or reflashed it, start over and sign in the way a new device does. Nothing on the Telegram servers is affected.
Every local file of this installation will be removed, including the history that cannot be read here anyway. The session on the servers stays alive until you end it from the device that owns it.
Can\'t check this data right now

The stored authorisation is sealed, and this phone\'s key store did not answer whether the key that opens it is here. Nothing has been read and nothing has been changed.\n\nTry again, or restart the app. Your data is not being deleted.
A copied application data folder signs nobody in on another device — even with no PIN set. Against code running as this app on this phone only a PIN helps.
Off — the data folder opens anywhere
Applying — the stored file has not been rewritten yet
On in the setting, not in effect: this phone\'s key store refused. It will be tried again at the next start.
This data belongs to another device

A channel can mark itself as auto-translated, and Telegram then turns translation on by itself — post text leaves the device while you read. NovaGram stops reading that mark. Translation you switch on by hand in a chat keeps working.

Uploads the number and the name of every phone book entry to Telegram, people who have no Telegram included. Off on new installs. Contacts already uploaded stay on the server: only the privacy settings of Telegram itself remove them.
A link is asking Telegram to send a confirmation code to %1$s. Any application or web page can hand such a link to the client, not only Telegram. Send the code?
A link is asking Telegram to send a confirmation code, but it names no number. Any application or web page can hand such a link to the client. Send the code?
A link wants to add somebody to your Telegram contacts and open a chat with them. Who it is becomes known only after Telegram is asked, so no name can be shown here. Add?

**%1$s** is asking for whatever you copied last. A clipboard often holds a password, a one-time code, or an address copied for something else, and whatever is handed over is kept by the server behind this mini app.

The stories row, the rings around avatars and the camera button are gone, and pulling the list down no longer brings them back. This is a screen setting: a story link opened from elsewhere still plays.
**%1$s** wants to build a story from a file on **%2$s**. Downloading it is a direct connection from this device to that host, outside the proxy, so it sees the real IP address.
